findings.title: No database migration files; schema managed exclusively via EnsureCreatedAsync()
findings.rule_violated: EF Core best practice: EnsureCreated() is for testing/in-memory scenarios only. Production apps must use migrations for versioned, upgradeable schema management.
findings.remediation: Run 'dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate' to generate a migration. Replace EnsureCreatedAsync() with Database.MigrateAsync() in Program.cs. This preserves data across schema changes and tracks model snapshots.

findings.title: Missing foreign key relationships in entity configuration
findings.rule_violated: EF Core schema integrity: without explicit FK configuration, referential integrity is not enforced at the database level. SQLite has FK enforcement off by default.
findings.remediation: Add Fluent API relationships (HasOne/WithMany/HasForeignKey/OnDelete) for EntryEntity->EntryScoreEntity, EntryScoreEntity->CategoryEntity, and RelationEntity->CategoryEntity. Enable foreign keys at connection open. Remove manual cascade deletion code in repository DeleteAsync methods after FKs are configured.

findings.title: Database restore overwrites file with active DbContext connection; swallowed exception masks data loss
findings.rule_violated: Best practice: never overwrite an open database file via raw filesystem I/O. Never swallow exceptions silently when data operations are at stake.
findings.remediation: Restructure startup: check LocalStorage for backup before creating the DbContext scope. Dispose of existing connection, restore file, then create fresh DbContext. Log ex.ToString() instead of ex.Message. Set an error flag for UI notification.

findings.title: O(n*m) client-side join in SqliteEntryRepository queries
findings.rule_violated: EF Core query efficiency: prefer database-side JOINs over client-side correlation loops. O(n*m) vs O(n) with SQL JOIN.
findings.remediation: Add a Category navigation property to EntryScoreEntity. Configure FK in OnModelCreating. Use .Include(e => e.Scores).ThenInclude(s => s.Category) and access scoreEntity.Category directly. This emits a single SQL JOIN.

findings.title: Missing .AsNoTracking() on all read-only repository queries
findings.rule_violated: EF Core performance best practice: use .AsNoTracking() for read-only queries to avoid change tracker overhead.
findings.remediation: Add .AsNoTracking() to GetAllAsync, GetByIdAsync, and GetByCategoryIdAsync queries. For UpdateAsync methods that mutate entities, keep tracking enabled.

findings.title: CalculateGlobalScoresAsync performs individual entry updates without transaction wrapping
findings.rule_violated: ACID best practice: multi-entity mutations representing a single logical operation must be wrapped in a transaction.
findings.remediation: Wrap the scoring loop in a transaction via _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(). Alternatively, refactor UpdateAsync to not call SaveChangesAsync internally and batch all changes in a single SaveChangesAsync call at the end of the loop.

findings.title: Connection string hardcoded in Program.cs rather than sourced from configuration
findings.rule_violated: Twelve-Factor App / .NET conventions: configuration should come from appsettings.json, environment variables, or configuration providers.
findings.remediation: Read connection string from builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("ContestDb") or appsettings. Store the DB path there. This also makes swapping to :memory: for tests trivial.

findings.title: Missing indexes on frequently queried foreign key columns
findings.rule_violated: Database performance: index columns used in WHERE and JOIN clauses.
findings.remediation: Add .HasIndex(r => r.CategoryId) on RelationEntity and .HasIndex(es => es.EntryId) on EntryScoreEntity in OnModelCreating.

findings.title: No error handling around SaveChangesAsync calls in repository methods
findings.rule_violated: Defensive programming: persistence operations should catch and wrap data-access exceptions with domain-meaningful error types.
findings.remediation: Wrap SaveChangesAsync() in try/catch. Catch DbUpdateException and inspect its inner exception to provide user-actionable messages. Re-throw as a custom domain exception or log with context.

findings.title: EntryScoreEntity has redundant surrogate key alongside natural composite unique constraint
findings.rule_violated: Schema normalization: avoid redundant surrogate keys when the natural key is sufficient and no referencing FKs require it.
findings.remediation: Remove the Id property and make (EntryId, CategoryId) the composite primary key via modelBuilder.Entity<EntryScoreEntity>().HasKey(es => new { es.EntryId, es.CategoryId }).

findings.title: DbContext class holds file I/O methods violating Single Responsibility Principle
findings.rule_violated: Single Responsibility Principle: the DbContext should only be responsible for database access and entity modeling, not filesystem I/O.
findings.remediation: Move ExportDatabaseAsync and ImportDatabaseAsync into a separate DatabaseBackupService registered in DI. The existing ContestManager delegates to these methods so refactoring is localized.

findings.title: No .IsRequired() or .HasMaxLength() configuration on string entity properties
findings.rule_violated: EF Core schema precision: explicit column constraints improve model clarity and enable database-level validation.
findings.remediation: Add .IsRequired() and .HasMaxLength(256) to all string PK/FK properties in OnModelCreating.
